subject: Vendor portal onboarding: CAIQ mapping + SSO proof for OmniCommerce
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@omnicommerce.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding: CAIQ mapping + SSO proof for OmniCommerce

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday — excited to get OmniCommerce into our Vendr profile. To speed the onboarding, two quick asks so our security team can finish the mapping: 

1) Can you share a CAIQ export or the CSV/JSON you get from your questionnaires?
2) We need a couple of SSO proof artifacts: SAML metadata URL or IDP metadata file, and one screenshot of the SSO login flow (user-facing).

I attached a short onboarding checklist that explains the expected evidence names and where we upload to Vendr. If it's easier we can do a 30-minute session next week to walk your DevOps through the upload.

Proposed next steps:
- You drop the CAIQ export and SSO metadata here or reply with a link (security@omnicommerce can chime in)
- We prepare a CAIQ->SIG mapping and upload a draft mapping to the portal for your review

Thanks — aiming for a soft launch of the profile by the end of next week if we can get the artifacts.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@omnicommerce.com>

Cc: OmniCommerce Security <security@omnicommerce.com>, devops@omnicommerce.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding: CAIQ mapping + SSO proof for OmniCommerce

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick update:

- I've attached a zip of our current CAIQ export (OmniCommerce_CAIQ_export.zip). It contains the standard JSON export from our portal.
- Our SAML metadata URL: https://sso.omnicommerce.com/metadata.xml
- DevOps grabbed a quick login screenshot and I'll bundle that if acceptable.

If you need anything else, let me know. We can do the 30-min session on Tue morning PST — Omar (devops@omnicommerce.com) is copied and can join.

Best,
Emily Hart
Head of IT Risk, OmniCommerce
Attachment: OmniCommerce_CAIQ_export.zip (zip)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor portal onboarding: CAIQ mapping + SSO proof for OmniCommerce

Kim / Marissa — forwarding OmniCommerce's initial payload. Emily attached a CAIQ export and gave the SAML metadata URL. Please: 

- Confirm whether the export maps cleanly to our SIG baseline. If anything looks off, note the gaps per section.
- Prepare a CAIQ_Mapping.xlsx with a row-per-question mapping (column: CAIQ_id, CAIQ_label, SIG_equivalent, evidence_required).
- Capture any follow-up asks we should surface to the customer (e.g., missing syslog retention docs).

Ben, flag if we should push for the Tue session or just upload the mapping first. I'll make the Vendr portal record and pre-fill the contact.

Thanks — Jordan

Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor portal onboarding: CAIQ mapping + SSO proof for OmniCommerce

Thanks — I pulled the export and started a mapping draft. High-level notes:

- ~85% of CAIQ questions map directly to our SIG baseline. A few areas to highlight:
  - Logging & retention: Omni's answers reference a multi-tenant syslog that doesn't include per-tenant retention guarantees. Ask: retention SLA and retention-policy docs.
  - Data classification: CAIQ Q2.* references an internal classification schema; we need the doc that shows mappings to PII/PCI scopes.
  - Backup & restore: their backup cadence is clear but proof of restore testing is missing. Request: one restore test report.

I've attached the CAIQ_Mapping.xlsx with color-coded rows for 'ok', 'clarify', and 'evidence_needed'. Also zipped a short set of SSO screenshots we captured from their test tenant (SSO_Screenshots.zip).

Planned next steps:
- Jordan: confirm whether we push the mapping to Vendr as a draft for the customer to review or hold until they provide the three missing artifacts (retention policy, classification doc, restore test).
- Marissa: please draft the follow-up email template to request those attachments and the proposed Tue 10:00am PST slot for a 30-min walk-through.

Kimberly Park
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: CAIQ_Mapping.xlsx (xlsx), SSO_Screenshots.zip (zip)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@omnicommerce.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding: CAIQ mapping + SSO proof for OmniCommerce

Emily — appreciate the quick turnaround and the SAML metadata link. Kimberly's team did a first-pass mapping and flagged three items we need to finish the profile:

- Retention policy that shows per-tenant syslog retention or an SLA commitment
- Data classification mapping to show where PII and regulated data are stored/segmented
- One restore test report (last 12 months) or a description of DR practice with an artifact

If you can drop those into the Vendr profile or reply with a link to the artifacts, we can mark the portal record as 'evidence_complete' and push the profile live. Otherwise the 30-min call Tue 10:00am PST still works — Omar, Kimberly and I will be on the call to help with uploads.

I'll upload the CAIQ_Mapping.xlsx as a draft to the portal and tag your team for review.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: CAIQ_Mapping.xlsx (xlsx)
